title: Stoneware Dinner Set for 4, 12 Pieces
description:
A versatile 12-piece stoneware set with a soft reactive glaze, so no two pieces look exactly alike. Sturdy enough for everyday meals and smart enough for guests.
• Includes 4 dinner plates (27 cm), 4 side plates (20 cm) and 4 bowls (15 cm)
• Glazed stoneware with a food-safe finish
• Dishwasher and microwave safe
• Set weight approx. 6 kg

title: Stainless Steel Cutlery Set for 6, 24 Pieces
description:
A classic, well-balanced cutlery set with a mirror-polished finish that suits any table. Each piece has a comfortable weight in the hand.
• Includes 6 each of dinner knives, dinner forks, dessert spoons and teaspoons
• 18/10 stainless steel, 2.5 mm thick
• Dishwasher safe; dry promptly for a lasting shine
• Presented in a gift box

title: Non-Stick Frying Pan 28 cm, Induction Compatible
description:
An everyday frying pan with a durable non-stick coating that releases eggs, pancakes and fish using very little oil. The heavy base spreads heat evenly on every hob.
• Diameter 28 cm, depth 5 cm, weight 1.1 kg
• Forged aluminium body with a 3-layer non-stick coating
• Works on gas, electric, ceramic and induction hobs
• Soft-touch handle; hand wash recommended

title: Stainless Steel Saucepan Set with Glass Lids, 3 Pieces
description:
Three nesting saucepans for sauces, soups, pasta and vegetables, each with a tempered glass lid and steam vent. The encapsulated base heats quickly and evenly.
• Sizes: 16 cm (1.5 L), 18 cm (2 L) and 20 cm (3 L)
• 18/8 stainless steel with internal measuring marks
• Suitable for all hobs including induction; oven safe to 200 °C without lids
• Dishwasher safe

title: Non-Stick 12-Cup Muffin Tin
description:
A sturdy carbon steel muffin tin that bakes evenly and releases muffins and cupcakes cleanly. Wide rolled edges make it easy to grip with oven gloves.
• 12 cups, each 7 cm across and 3 cm deep
• Overall size: 35 × 26.5 cm
• Heavy-gauge carbon steel with a double non-stick coating, oven safe to 230 °C
• Hand wash recommended

title: Teak Wooden Cooking Utensil Set, 6 Pieces
description:
Smooth teak utensils that are gentle on non-stick pans and comfortable to hold. A natural-looking set for stirring, flipping and serving.
• Includes spatula, slotted spatula, solid spoon, slotted spoon, salad spoon and ladle
• Solid teak wood, 30–33 cm long
• Heat resistant and kind to non-stick coatings
• Hand wash and oil occasionally

title: Stainless Steel Mini Grater with Heart Cut-Outs
description:
A small, sharp grater for garlic, ginger, nutmeg, citrus zest and hard cheese, with playful heart-shaped holes. Compact enough to grate straight over the plate.
• Size: 15 × 5.5 cm
• Food-grade stainless steel
• Fine, sharp holes for zest and spices
• Hanging loop; dishwasher safe

title: Glass Meal Prep Containers with Snap Lids, Set of 5
description:
Leak-resistant glass containers for meal prep, leftovers and packed lunches. They go from fridge or freezer to microwave or oven (without the lids).
• 5 containers, 1,040 ml each, 20 × 15 × 6 cm
• Borosilicate glass, oven safe to 230 °C without lids
• Four-latch lids with silicone seal, BPA-free
• Dishwasher safe

title: Glass Storage Jars with Bamboo Lids, Set of 6
description:
Airtight glass jars that keep pasta, rice, grains and snacks fresh and on show. The bamboo lids seal with a silicone ring.
• 6 jars: 2 × 1,000 ml, 2 × 650 ml and 2 × 450 ml
• Borosilicate glass with bamboo lids
• Silicone sealing ring for an airtight fit
• Includes 12 reusable labels and a chalk marker

title: Microfibre Duvet Cover Set 200 × 200 cm with 2 Pillowcases
description:
A soft, brushed microfibre bedding set that feels cosy in winter and stays breathable in summer. Easy-care fabric that resists creases and dries quickly.
• Duvet cover 200 × 200 cm with hidden zip closure
• 2 pillowcases 80 × 80 cm with envelope closure
• 100% brushed polyester microfibre, 90 g/m²
• Machine washable at 40 °C, tumble dry low

title: Stonewashed Cotton Pillowcases 50 × 75 cm, Set of 2
description:
Relaxed, softly textured pillowcases in stonewashed cotton that get softer with every wash. The casual, lived-in look suits any bedroom.
• Size: 50 × 75 cm, set of 2
• 100% cotton, stonewashed for softness
• Envelope closure keeps the pillow in place
• Machine washable at 40 °C

title: Cotton Bath Towel Set, 4 Pieces
description:
Plush, absorbent towels in heavyweight cotton that feel soft from the very first wash. A matching set for a calm, hotel-style bathroom.
• Includes 2 bath towels (70 × 140 cm) and 2 hand towels (50 × 90 cm)
• 100% cotton terry, 550 g/m²
• Hanging loop on every towel
• Machine washable at 60 °C

title: Non-Slip Microfibre Bath Mat, 50 × 80 cm
description:
A thick, quick-drying bath mat with soft microfibre loops that soak up water from wet feet. The rubberised backing helps keep it in place on tiles.
• Size: 50 × 80 cm, pile height 2.5 cm
• Microfibre chenille top with non-slip TPR backing
• Machine washable at 30 °C; air dry
• Also works well in kitchens and entryways

title: Ceramic Vase Set of 3, Matte Neutral Finish
description:
Three minimalist vases in soft, earthy tones that work alone or grouped on a shelf, mantel or table. Display fresh flowers or dried stems, or simply leave them empty.
• Heights: 20 cm, 15 cm and 11 cm
• Matte-glazed ceramic, glazed inside to hold water
• Felt pads on the base protect furniture
• Wipe clean with a damp cloth

title: Cushion Covers 45 × 45 cm, Set of 4
description:
A coordinated set of four cushion covers to refresh a sofa or bed in minutes. Soft woven fabric with hidden zips for a neat finish.
• Size: 45 × 45 cm, set of 4 (inserts not included)
• Material: polyester and linen blend
• Concealed zip closure
• Machine washable at 30 °C

title: Woven Seagrass Storage Baskets, Set of 3
description:
Handwoven seagrass baskets with built-in handles for tidying toys, towels, blankets and plants. The natural texture adds warmth to any room.
• Sizes (diameter × height): 38 × 30 cm, 32 × 26 cm and 26 × 22 cm
• Natural seagrass with woven handles
• Nest inside one another when not in use
• Spot clean only

title: Expandable Bamboo Cutlery Drawer Organiser
description:
A bamboo tray that expands to fit most kitchen drawers, keeping cutlery, utensils and gadgets neatly sorted. Also handy in desks and bathroom drawers.
• Expands from 33 to 53 cm wide; depth 43 cm; height 5 cm
• 5 to 7 compartments depending on width
• Natural bamboo with a smooth lacquered finish
• Wipe clean; non-slip feet

title: Amber Glass Spray Bottles 500 ml, Set of 2
description:
Refillable glass spray bottles for homemade cleaning solutions, plant misting or ironing water. The adjustable trigger switches between fine mist and stream.
• 2 bottles × 500 ml, amber glass
• Adjustable trigger: mist, stream or off
• Includes chalk labels and a small funnel
• Rinse between refills; not for use with bleach

title: Round Wooden Side Table with Shelf, 45 cm
description:
A compact round side table with a lower shelf for books, magazines or a plant. The warm wood finish suits Scandinavian and modern rooms alike.
• Size: 45 cm diameter × 50 cm height
• Engineered wood top with wood veneer and solid pine legs
• Maximum load: 15 kg on the top, 10 kg on the shelf
• Simple assembly, tools included

title: Soy Wax Scented Candle in Amber Glass Jar, 200 g
description:
A slow-burning soy wax candle with a cotton wick and a warm, inviting fragrance. The amber glass jar can be reused once the candle has burned down.
• 200 g soy wax blend, burn time approx. 40 hours
• Cotton wick; jar size 8 × 9 cm with metal lid
• Trim the wick to 5 mm before each use
• Never leave a burning candle unattended; full safety information on the label
